search_window.basis: Begins at last independently read-back verified Food Line heartbeat completed_at. One- and two-day search recency was used to accommodate indexing lag; only newly reported or newly substantiated disruptions since prior check qualify.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value miss recall; primary nationwide Food Line production collection remains authoritative.

Cancellation or suspension of emergency food distribution due to weather, flood, fire, outage or facility damage

New official SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes.observation: No independently confirmed qualifying U.S. food-access disruption first reported or newly substantiated in this observation window. Results mostly concerned prior-month grocery closures, ownership transfers without demonstrated current access loss, reopening of a pantry closed three months earlier, historical storm reports, or 2025 SNAP interruption alerts. Source publication and underlying event dates were used rather than crawl dates.

excluded_examples.reason: St. George-area Salvation Army pantry reopening after a closure approximately three months earlier; no newly occurring service loss this hour.
New ownership announcement for De Pere/Kaukauna, not current closure; Little Chute closing was reported October 1, before window.
Supermarket ownership transition in Easthampton, not an established sole/full-service grocery closure or immediate interruption.
Older storm recovery information without new cancellation of food distribution.
2025 SNAP shutdown reporting; not a new 2026 official interruption.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched and inspected last specified heartbeat from ops/watch-ledger; no new positive records to compare.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve query-bounded web searches are supplemental, not exhaustive; no provider or state agency notice corroborated a new interruption in this hour. Historical reports and sale/reopening stories are not treated as fresh access losses.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, main collector change, schedule change or task disabling.
